snippet.title: Poolcore Reflection | Poolrooms: Spooky or Not?
snippet.description:
Bonus video! Here's a game that came out very recently! I don't think it's meant to be spooky...

Check out some of my other series:

Cry of Fear: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gvNdyDWjNzw&list=PL05Yc3_TEBpMFMNFbxq3wij1zSz6hhQYl

Gatling Gears: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dfn_NOWbuMY&list=PL342068E1CF3BE639

Indiana Jones and the Emperor’s Tomb: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xSUoPj3fSI8&list=PL05Yc3_TEBpPb8XWjX6WuQev44Ltr_PMj

Want to follow me on social media?

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/General-Red-Strategist-1429599034013893/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/GRStrategist

Also, interested in seeing me react to anime and other non-gaming content? Be sure to check out my second channel, Propagandist: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCkwjoUf52HcAQF1alQpW3Xw

Intro music: extract from The Liberty Bell March by John Philip Sousa, performed by the US Marines Band and available on Musopen.org under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported licence.

Outro music: extract from In The Hall Of The Mountain King composed by Edvard Grieg, available on Musopen.org in the public domain.

Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported licence: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

Outro footage taken from archive.org, licensed under Creative Commons/public domain.

Music used in the video: Cool Vibes by Kevin Macleod (incompetech) licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.
